The leaked content was itself non-sensitive (copies of this repo's own LICENSE/README/pyproject.toml/two schema READMEs, no secrets or private DeepSeek content). Fully eliminated by building from a clean `git clone` instead -- confirmed by direct archive-content inspection of the actual RC sdist/wheel, which contain none of it. Documented as a build-process finding and mitigated by process (clean checkout), not by altering packaging source, per the phase's no-unnecessary-production-change instruction.
